links.outcome: Expert ORL consultant ratings of LLM recommendations for patient safety risk on real cases
links.effect: Consultants judged LLM recommendations hazardous in 54% (Llama 3), 47% (Gemma 2), and 32% (Mistral Nemo) of ratings versus 1% for ORL doctors.
links.quote: ORL doctors' responses were considered hazardous for patients in only 1% of the ratings, whereas recommendations by Llama 3, Gemma 2, and Mistral Nemo were considered hazardous in 54%, 47%, and 32% of cases, respectively.

links.outcome: Comparison of LLM recommendations with treating doctors' recommendations on medical adequacy and other ratings
links.effect: ORL doctors achieved superior ratings compared with all three locally run LLMs across all categories (P<.0005).
links.quote: Over all categories, ORL doctors achieved superior (P<.0005) ratings compared to locally run LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral Nemo, and Gemma 2).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of locally run LLMs (Gemma 2, Mistral Nemo, Llama 3) for ORL diagnosis and treatment recommendations assessed by expert clinician raters for accuracy and safety hazard.
